     Update "version" and the lists with each release. -->
version: 0.5.0
tagline: A new Solo layout, settings with tabs, and boss fights counted right from the pull.

## New
- 🪪 **Solo layout:** just you, in a small card (your DPS, rank, crit, double, perfect, front and back), switch with Ctrl+Shift+O
- 🗂️ **Settings with tabs** and a search box, so every option is easy to find
- 👥 **Players listed: Auto:** your party when you're in one, everyone when you're solo, with nothing to set
- 🖱️ **Ctrl + mouse wheel** over the meter makes it bigger or smaller
- 🎨 **New event and Odyle icons**, and Mac-style window buttons

## Fixed
- ⚔️ **Boss fights count from the pull,** even when your party started before you got there
- 🎯 **The card follows the monster you're fighting** after a boss, and stays on the boss during the fight
- 👥 **Your whole party is seen:** open-world parties, dungeon rooms, members not Ready yet, and leaving a party
- 🙋 **Party names from the first boss,** and your own name instead of *You*
- 💎 **Odyle, health bars and narrow meters** show the right thing
